title: Private Getty Center 1-Hour Tour for Kids Ages 6-12
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
For groups of over 8, there is an additional cost per person.
For children 6-12 years of age. All children must be accompanied by an adult(s)
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: We provide an introduction to the art world that emphasizes how to look at and what to look for when viewing any work of art. By utilizing visual and tactile aids, we involve the child in the techniques, process and artists’ motivations. At the same time, we ensure the adult chaperones (over 18) are entertained as well. After the tour, you'll be amazed by the shared discoveries you have experienced together. In addition, each child is presented with an “Art Appreciation Badge”. We do not recommend this tour for children under 6 unless they are in a stroller. Want a time that's not posted? Just ask! Have a group larger than 6? We can accommodate up to 35 people. Prices upon request.
